vis.alt: Steps of thyroid hormone synthesis: iodide trapping by the sodium iodide symporter, oxidation and organification by thyroid peroxidase onto thyroglobulin, coupling of MIT and DIT into T3 and T4 in colloid, then endocytosis and proteolysis releasing T4 and T3.
vis.caption: Trap, oxidise, organify, couple, store, then endocytose and release; thyroid peroxidase is the target of carbimazole.

vis.alt: Table of thyroid hormone actions by system: raises basal metabolic rate and heat production, upregulates beta receptors, essential for fetal and childhood brain and bone growth, speeds gut motility.
vis.caption: Thyroid hormone raises metabolism, heat, heart rate and gut motility; in infancy it is essential for brain development.

vis.alt: Table of thyroid function test patterns: primary hypothyroidism high TSH low free T4, subclinical high TSH normal T4, secondary hypothyroidism low or normal TSH low T4, Graves disease low TSH high T4, rare TSH producing adenoma high TSH high T4.
vis.caption: Read TSH first: high TSH with low T4 is primary hypothyroidism; low TSH with high T4 is primary hyperthyroidism.
